tokens.v: The signet rests face-up on deep-green marble at a hotel bar in golden lamplight, beside a half-poured coupe and a folded linen napkin, the bar's brass rail running a warm line out of focus behind. 100mm macro at f/2.8 level with the band, the brushed gold holding one soft window of light and the polished face mirroring the pendant lamps as a single stretched highlight. A hand reaches in from the right, blurred mid-motion about to take it, cut by the right edge. Inside the band the LUMEN & CO. hallmark catches a point of lamplight. The marble's veining runs sharp under the ring and melts into bokeh within a hand's width.
